method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (an employer outside the Comcare scheme answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Safety, Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 1988, Compilation No. 82, compilation date 1 July 2026 (register id C2026C00285, retrieved 2026-09-22), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A03668.txt. No instrument brought in; the formulas of ss 8, 16(6), 19, 27 and 13AA are missing from the deposit and are not supplied; indexed amounts and the approved Guide's percentages are inputs.

scope: From the seat of the injured employee: s 5(1) (employee), ss 5A, 5B, 6 (injury, disease, the s 6 circumstances, s 6(1C) commute, s 6(3) abnormal risk), s 14 (liability), ss 53, 54 (notice, claim, certificate), s 16(1), (2), (6)-(7) (medical expenses; travel eligibility only), s 19(2), (2A), (3) (which weekly rate, the adjustment percentage; not the amount), s 23(1), (1A), (2), ss 24, 25(4)-(5), 26(1)-(2) (permanent impairment, maximum amount as an input), s 17(2)-(4) (death lump sum, indexed amount as an input), ss 60(1), 62(3), 64(1) (reconsideration and review). Out: s 7, s 8, s 15, amounts under ss 16, 17(5), 18, s 19(2B)-(2D), (3A)-(14), ss 20-22, 23A, 25(1)-(3), 27, 29-31, Parts III, IV, ss 55-59, Parts VII onwards, Defence service; other employers (not covered).
seat: the injured employee of the Commonwealth, a Commonwealth authority or a licensed corporation (and, for s 17, the dependant asking about the employee's death)
